description: Record placed generator winding, rotor, motor and transformer assembly parameters with circuit state when an instrumented test can expose them; do not treat configured limits as actual output.

conditions.assembly: ordinary batteries can form a capacity-scaled multiblock
conditions.not_a_rating: no fixed safe charging voltage or current inferred

value: State of charge determines source voltage and internal resistance. Circuit current changes stored energy each tick; the value is clamped between empty and assembled capacity.

conditions.components: 26 loaded component mappings captured in adapter definitions and relationships

value: A placed board reads the schematic, derives its required component items, and builds a circuit from the design.

explanation: All four boostable tools have reviewed action-path behavior with effective base charge costs separately captured.

conditions.methods: see captured peripheral adapter and device-specific claims

value: The installed CC bridge registers peripheral capabilities for redstone converter, battery, energy meter, generator clutch, and gauge devices.

explanation: Component mappings and schematic-to-board flow are reviewed; a representative custom circuit still needs an end-to-end in-world build test.
All 26 loaded circuit components have captured mappings; table and board schematic flow is source reviewed.

value: A controllable contactor builds two switched wire paths; its state can drive a 0/15 comparator signal and stacked contactors are supported.

explanation: Contactor switching is reviewed in addition to prior fuse, breaker and LV/MV switch findings.
Contactor, fuse and breaker paths are reviewed; relay, redstone and high-voltage switch interactions need full circuit tests.

value: The design table edits a schematic and writes or reads it on a schematic item; the custom design is serialized in item data.

explanation: Generator winding/EMF, motor load, transformer coupling and FE inverter controls were reviewed; assembly-dependent outputs remain conditional.

value: Boosting keeps the configured base charge cost, but raises the effect cap from 30 to 60 and slow duration from 60 to 120 ticks.
Boosting keeps the configured base shot cost and doubles a projectile parameter; precise damage and range are not inferred.

conditions.control: throttle derives from control-capacitor voltage and configured control voltage
conditions.energy_port: FE capability is exposed on the facing side

explanation: Assembly-specific generator/transformer outputs and remaining kinetic devices need placed-system tests before a complete design guide.

conditions.meaning: EMF, not guaranteed loaded terminal voltage

explanation: Installed CC, Create, Simulated and Sable bridges are distinguished from optional absent integrations.
Loaded bridge registration is reviewed; per-device API behavior and Sable/Simulated usage need focused loaded-server tests.
Gauge, energy meter, multimeter, thermometer, plotter and modular-display behavior has artifact-backed findings.
Device paths are reviewed, but display scaling and plotter timing need placed-device verification.

value: Display modules select and color measurement slots; display state is electrically updated and thermal slots can blank on overheating.
Electrical input power and Create stress determine rotational speed and torque; the dynamic-resistance setting changes the electrical load model.
Terminal probing measures voltage; probing a wire measures current. Main-hand shift interaction clears the probe connection; voltage and current warnings use separate effective limits.
Connected sampling wires feed a recorded buffer; kinetic speed changes sampling, and the plotter supports per-trace color and maximum-value controls.
Boosted mining doubles charge draw; the drill's speed settings are captured separately.

explanation: Boosted action paths are reviewed; zapper projectile effect and battery supply behavior need focused in-world tests.

value: Boosted mining doubles charge draw and destroy speed; crouching can invoke Create tree cutting.
Source voltage and resistance follow state of charge; terminal behavior also depends on connected load.

conditions.state: bridge registration; no fixed thrust rating inferred

value: The installed Sable bridge substitutes an electric-fan block entity and tracks ship sublevel transitions for entities.
The installed Simulated bridge registers five sensor sources with Power Grid's redstone converter registry.

explanation: Battery charge-dependent voltage, resistance, energy update and multiblock capacity were reviewed against the exact artifact; effective values are captured.
Exact in-world charge acceptance and thermal safety under representative circuits still need focused testing; no universal safe-input limit was found.

conditions.meaning: display warning bands, not material failure ratings

value: Reports current and maximum observed temperature through its dial, redstone output and goggle tooltip; tooltip warning colors change at 125, 150 and 175°C.

conditions.assembly: both winding configurations and terminal pairs must be present

value: Configured primary and secondary turns, core inductance and coupling create a coupled-inductor circuit. Turn ratio alone does not guarantee a fixed loaded output voltage.

conditions.assembly: actual placed windings; no universal fixed output

value: Winding resistance depends on the count of connected coils and parallel winding paths; the simulated winding also has inductance proportional to resistance.

conditions.scope: wire type and placed geometry determine resistance

conditions.separate_behavior: wire cutting and entity shock are separate interactions

value: The wire has a 175°C default overheat threshold. Two consecutive heating ticks above it set an overheated state and client visual effects; the inspected path does not automatically remove or damage the wire.

explanation: Wire resistance, thermal mass and cooling factors are runtime captured; overheat threshold and visual consequences were reviewed in the artifact.
Thermal behavior is reviewed; wire cutting, entity shock and connector topology need focused interaction tests.

value: When enabled and the simulation has converged, absolute current above the configured scroll setting opens the switched wire; a zero setting disables this trip.

conditions.availability: registered capability; placed block and connection conditions still apply

value: energy
getValue
maxRange
Current through the gauge's series wire

conditions.units: Wh or kWh according to precision mode

value: Per game tick, adds measured current × shunt potential difference × 0.05 divided by 3600 in Wh mode or 3,600,000 in kWh mode; stored display wraps at 100,000 in either direction.

conditions.mode: comparator pulse; not a continuous 0–15 energy level

value: On two-tick electrical updates, the meter emits a clamped 0–15 comparator pulse for whole-unit increases and resets the pulse on the next interval.
resetFuse changes open or blown to closed; removeBlown changes only blown to open.

conditions.threshold: effective in-world scroll setting; exact unit and range unresolved

value: On a converged simulation with a closed fuse, absolute current above the scroll setting changes fuse state to blown.

conditions.visual_dial: can reach 1.125 of selected full scale

value: Gauge redstone output is the floored, clamped dial fraction times 15; output saturates at signal 15 even when the visual dial overranges.

conditions.value: dynamic; no fixed voltage rating inferred

value: Generated voltage depends on kinetic speed, field strength, winding properties and assembled generator state.

conditions.meaning: hazard trigger in this implementation, not a promise of safety below 48 V

value: The rod checks approximately every 10 game ticks; a modeled rod potential magnitude at or above 48 V can damage nearby entities.
A ground path is enabled only after enough connected conductive blocks are counted; its resistance varies with the count and configured endpoints.
